item.title: Unpacking Digitalization: Antecedents, Strategies, and Performance Implications
item.content:encoded:
Jasmina Berbegal-Mirabent, Polytechnic University of Catalonia

Angelo Cavallo, Politecnico di Milano

Antje Fiedler, University of Auckland

Esteban Lafuente, Costa Rica Institute of Technology

Organizations across private and public sectors face challenges integrating digital technologies. While digitalization offers innovation and performance opportunities, many organizations struggle with resource constraints, knowledge gaps, and organizational inertia. The literature remains fragmented on how digitalization unfolds across different contexts, particularly for SMEs and public service providers lacking the resources of large corporations.

This special issue examines how organizations conceive, deploy, and leverage digital strategies. It seeks research on the factors driving digitalization decisions, mechanisms linking digital transformation to individual and organizational outcomes, and how human-technology interactions shape success. Studies on private firms, universities, hospitals, and public administrations are welcome, including the 'dark side' of digitalization such as technology-resource misalignment.

Appel publié par Review of Managerial Science. Lire l'appel complet sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
